title: Lag-1 median order-statistic state memory

source.reconciliation: data/storico_daily.csv matches src/data.json:modelDraws row-for-row on all 3,404 dates and five-number sets.

hypothesis: The previous draw's third order statistic (median) may add one-step information about the next draw's median beyond its exact combinatorial marginal distribution.

definition.feature: M_t = the third sorted number in draw D_t

models.M1: One-step categorical shrinkage conditional on previous median s: p_t(m|s) = [alpha*q0(m) + N_{s,m}(t)]/[alpha + N_s(t)].

walk_forward.chronological_splits: 60% discovery / 20% validation / remaining 20% historical blind OOS; floor for first two segments.
walk_forward.cutoff_rule: For target index t, only transition pairs (M_i,M_{i+1}) with i+1 <= t-1 may enter the forecast. Forecast uses the previous draw as state; target outcome is scored only after forecast construction.
walk_forward.inference: Historical blind OOS only. Discovery and Validation are descriptive; no tuning is performed.

primary: M0 minus M1 multiclass Brier loss (positive favors M1)
M0 minus M1 multiclass log-loss (positive favors M1)
endpoints.multiple_testing: Holm step-down across the two preregistered Blind OOS endpoints.

guardrails: No parameter, state-binning, subgroup or feature search after observing outcomes.
No target or future draw is used in forecast construction.
All probabilities are normalized over the 36 possible median values.
Historical Blind OOS is not a virgin holdout; earlier SONAR work examined related order-statistic and geometric summaries. Q110 is exploratory, not confirmatory.
The result concerns only the next draw's median, not individual number probabilities or a complete quintet.
Q60 outcome reconciliation may update only pre-existing 2026-11-10 freeze outcome fields using the official archive result; forecast lists and frozen_at/history_cutoff are immutable.
No production scorer change, no model promotion, no auto-merge.
